name: nose-review
description: Review pushed code for duplication and resolve findings with Nose Fix

interface.shortDescription: Block unreviewed duplication before push and resolve findings.
interface.longDescription: Automatically registers a preserving, blocking Git pre-push gate when a trusted Codex project session starts. Reviews pushed commits against committed decisions and guides authorized agent pushes through Nose Fix and retry.
defaultPrompt: Review my current code changes for duplication.
